en.title: Fantastic end: France beats Senegal thanks to Mbappé
en.summary: After the 2018 World Cup victory and the narrow 2022 final defeat against Argentina, France is once again reaching for the title this year - and this mission began this Tuesday with a hard-earned 3-1victory over an initially cheeky Senegal.

fr.title: Conclusion de rêve : la France bat le Sénégal grâce à Mbappé

es.title: Final de ensueño: Francia vence a Senegal gracias a Mbappé

ar.title: نهاية رائعة: فرنسا تهزم السنغال بفضل مبابي
